# stored in

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:storedIn`](gmeow-storedIn.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/storedIn>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a digital object (e.g. a document or import source) to the storage location where its bytes reside — the structured form of a source's location.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) -> [`gmeow:StorageLocation`](../classes/gmeow-StorageLocation.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:locatedAt`](gmeow-locatedAt.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:storedIn`](gmeow-storedIn.md) from [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) to [`gmeow:StorageLocation`](../classes/gmeow-StorageLocation.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:locatedAt`](gmeow-locatedAt.md), [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md), [`gmeow:StorageLocation`](../classes/gmeow-StorageLocation.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record where a digital object's bytes reside — the structured form of a source's location — as a specialization of [`gmeow:locatedAt`](gmeow-locatedAt.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a person or device being somewhere (use [`gmeow:locatedAt`](gmeow-locatedAt.md)) and avoid pointing it at a geographic [`Place`](../classes/gmeow-Place.md); its range is [`StorageLocation`](../classes/gmeow-StorageLocation.md).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:storedIn`](gmeow-storedIn.md) from the digital object to a [`StorageLocation`](../classes/gmeow-StorageLocation.md), and link that store's device site via [`gmeow:physicalPlace`](gmeow-physicalPlace.md) when geography matters.

- ex:report [`gmeow:storedIn`](gmeow-storedIn.md) ex:bucket.
